blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The House Committee on Natural Resources began deliberations on Wednesday on four bills seeking to declare the Verde Island Passage (VIP) a protected seascape under the Expanded National Integrated Protected Areas System (ENIPAS). The measures provide legal protection for the marine corridor, which spans waters off Batangas, Oriental Mindoro, Occidental Mindoro and Marinduque. Oriental Mindoro 1st District Rep. Arnan Panaligan, Negros Occidental 3rd District Rep. Javi Benitez, Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima, and Batangas 3rd District Rep. King Collantes filed the bills.
